visited_flags = [0] * p

while start_point < p:
    if visited_flags[start_point]:
        start_point += 1
        continue
    current = start_point
    while True:
        visited_flags[current] = 1
        current = (current * k) % p
        if start_point == current or current == 0:
            break
    total_product = (total_product * p) % 1000000007
    start_point += 1
